Description: The outturn on the plan basis (Outturn (plan basis), through Comparison Amount). Chosen over plain Outturn so that Actual, Plan and Variance in one row are on the same basis: Variance would not equal Actual less Plan if Actual held every control budget and Plan only DEL. On Statement Amount it is the amount on the plan's basis where the statement line has a plan, and the statement amount itself on every other line. Pass-through for other measures.
Expression: IF ( ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Statement Amount] ), COALESCE ( [Statement Amount (plan basis)], SELECTEDMEASURE () ), SELECTEDMEASURE () )

Description: The published plan (Plan), BLANK below its grain. On Statement Amount it is Statement Plan. Acts only on Comparison Amount and Statement Amount.
Expression:
IF (
    ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Comparison Amount] ),
    [Plan],
    IF ( ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Statement Amount] ), [Statement Plan], SELECTEDMEASURE () )
)

Description: Actual less Plan in GBP thousands. With spending positive and income negative, a negative variance is favourable for both spending (under plan) and income (more income than planned, which is more negative). BLANK when either side is BLANK.
Expression:
IF (
    ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Comparison Amount] ),
    VAR Actual = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
    VAR PlanAmount = [Plan]
    RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PlanAmount ), BLANK (), Actual - PlanAmount ),
    IF ( ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Statement Amount] ), [Statement Variance], SELECTEDMEASURE () )
)

Description: Variance divided by the absolute plan, so the sign is the sign of the variance (negative is favourable) whether the plan is spending or income. BLANK when the plan is zero or either side is BLANK.
Expression:
IF (
    ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Comparison Amount] ),
    VAR Actual = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
    VAR PlanAmount = [Plan]
    RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PlanAmount ), BLANK (), DIVIDE ( Actual - PlanAmount, ABS ( PlanAmount ) ) ),
    IF ( ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Statement Amount] ), [Statement Variance %], SELECTEDMEASURE () )
)

Description: A signed indicator: 1 where the variance is favourable (below zero), -1 where it is adverse (above zero), 0 where actual equals plan, BLANK where there is no variance. A number, so that conditional formatting can use rules on it; its format string shows the words Favourable, Adverse and On plan.
Expression:
IF (
    ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Comparison Amount] ),
    VAR Actual = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
    VAR PlanAmount = [Plan]
    VAR Difference = IF ( ISBLANK ( Actual ) || ISBLANK ( PlanAmount ), BLANK (), Actual - PlanAmount )
    RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( Difference ), BLANK (), IF ( Difference < 0, 1, IF ( Difference > 0, -1, 0 ) ) ),
    IF (
        ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Statement Amount] ),
        VAR StatementDifference = [Statement Variance] * Pnl.SignFactor ()
        RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( StatementDifference ), BLANK (), SIGN ( -StatementDifference ) ),
        SELECTEDMEASURE ()
    )
)

Description: The measure in the period context of the visual: a month in a month row, the year in a year row.
The month: the latest allocated month (period 1 to 12) in context. Period 0, amounts the source does not allocate to a month, is never a month.
Quarter to date: the months of the fiscal quarter (April to June is quarter 1) of the latest allocated month in context, up to that month. The quarter is derived from the month.
Year to date: period 0 to the latest period in context in each financial year. Period 0 is counted, so the year to date at period 12 is the year total.
The same periods in the previous financial year (a whole year gives the previous year, period 0 included).

Current less PY. BLANK where there is no previous year (the first year of the data), and for Variance % and Favourable/Adverse and the share measures (Revision %, Estimated Mapping Share), where a difference between two ratios or two indicators means nothing.
Expression:
VAR Comparison = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] )
VAR CurrentValue = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
VAR PriorValue = Window.PriorYear ( SELECTEDMEASURE () )
RETURN
    IF (
        Comparison IN { "Variance %", "Favourable/Adverse" } || ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Revision %], [Estimated Mapping Share] ) || ISBLANK ( CurrentValue ) || ISBLANK ( PriorValue ),
        BLANK (),
        CurrentValue - PriorValue
    )

Description: Current less PY, divided by the absolute PY. BLANK where there is no previous year, where PY is zero, and for Variance % and Favourable/Adverse and the share measures (a percentage change of a ratio or an indicator is meaningless).
Expression:
VAR Comparison = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Scenario Comparison'[Comparison] )
VAR CurrentValue = SELECTEDMEASURE ()
VAR PriorValue = Window.PriorYear ( SELECTEDMEASURE () )
RETURN
    IF (
        Comparison IN { "Variance %", "Favourable/Adverse" } || ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Revision %], [Estimated Mapping Share] ) || ISBLANK ( CurrentValue ) || ISBLANK ( PriorValue ),
        BLANK (),
        DIVIDE ( CurrentValue - PriorValue, ABS ( PriorValue ) )
    )

Description: The 12 allocated months ending at the latest allocated month in context, crossing financial years. Period 0 is not a month and is not in the window. Plan is BLANK here, because a rolling window is never a published plan period.
